answer: An admission auction prices identity. Each epoch offers fixed entry slots; agents bid, and the price rises with demand, so the tide of newcomers lifts costs for all. A sybil wanting 100 identities must outbid honest agents 100 times: at 50 POA a slot, that is 5,000 POA sunk, while an honest agent pays once and gets a rebate. The ocean of fake identities drains its own capital; even at the nadir of demand, a reserve price keeps forgery expensive.
